messages.text: I'm shocked I've had this minor going on two weeks you guys know about it and you're doing nothing somebody needs to please get back to me. Rob L. (phone hidden) (email hidden)
Used the store-orders skill
Handed to the team · Customer asked for a human. Earlier technical flag to JD has had no reply he can

I've passed this to the team and asked for a person to get back to you, Rob. You're right to push. Your KBOX on Shop···· was delivered October 29, it's been reading close to zero for nearly two weeks, and you haven't had a real answer. I'm sorry about that.

The team is offline for the weekend. They'll pick it up Monday at 10am ET, and their answer goes to (email hidden)

If you want to reach JD before then, the quickest way is Discord: https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf. Post a photo of the dashboard and mention @nullhashrate.
Please stay in contact

I will, Rob. Your case stays open until someone from the team has actually dealt with it. Their reply goes to (email hidden), and you can write in here anytime in the meantime.

One thing that would speed it up on Monday: a photo of the KBOX dashboard showing the hashrate, chip count and temperature. Post it here or in the Discord.
This thing hashes 0.044....

Thanks, Rob. 0.044 TH/s on a box rated for 22 TH/s means it's basically not hashing at all. With the case staying cold, that points to the hashboards not running. More time or more settings changes won't fix that.

I've added that reading to your case, so the team can see it with the earlier ones on Monday.

One question they'll ask: has the KBOX ever been overclocked or put on different firmware? You can leave it powered off until then.
I've given it before I will give them again right now

You're right, Rob. You've been asked for the same things too many times, and I'm sorry about that.

Go ahead and post it here. It'll be on your case with everything else, so on Monday nobody needs to ask you for it again.
(The customer sent this photo without a message.)

Got it, Rob, thanks. The screen shows 0.355 TH/s on a unit rated for 22 TH/s, so it's running at under 2% of what it should. The photo is on your case along with your earlier readings, so you don't need to send it again.

The one thing still open is whether it's ever been overclocked or run on different firmware. A yes or no is all they need.
Can only send one pic at a time
That's fine, Rob. Send them one at a time and each one will go on your case as it comes in.

Got it, Rob. This one shows 0.631 TH/s with the temperature at 109.6°F and the fan at 1710 RPM. The fan is running and the temperature looks normal. So it isn't overheating, it's just hashing at about 3% of the 22 TH/s it's rated for.

That's on your case too. Keep sending any others you have.
(The customer sent this photo without a message.)

Got it, Rob. This one reads 0.877 TH/s, still only about 4% of what it's rated for. It's on your case with the other photos.

Send any others you have. When you're done, the one thing still open is a yes or no on whether it's ever been overclocked or run on different firmware.

Between this and the photos, they have everything they need. The only thing still open is a yes or no on whether it's ever been overclocked or run on different firmware.

They pick it up Monday at 10am ET and their answer goes to (email hidden) Until then you can leave the unit powered off.
